narrative_purpose: Establishes the before-and-after of Spider's transformation at a glance: the same human, once tethered to a breathing mask, now breathing the open air unaided.
subject: A single human figure shown twice, side by side against the same Pandoran forest night: on the left, the figure wears a sealed breathing mask over nose and mouth, a faint tube and the reflective visor marking total dependence on filtered air, the skin ordinary; on the right, the same figure stands with no mask at all, head tilted back drawing an open breath, and beneath the skin of the throat and chest a soft cyan network of fine threads now glows, marking the living filter within.
scene: A two-figure comparison of one person before and after, masked versus unmasked, in the same setting.
camera: A flat frontal comparison view, both figures at equal size, a soft vertical seam of darkness dividing the two states.
light: Cool bioluminescent ambient from the forest; the right figure carries an added inner cyan glow beneath the skin; the left figure lit only by cold external light on the mask visor.
palette: Void-indigo base, Pandora cyan and living teal, the masked side cooler and dimmer, the unmasked side carrying the added inner glow; no warm accents.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence, luminous and atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp on the mask and visor at left and on the under-skin glow at right; the shared forest background kept dim and simple.
composition: Two equal figures facing forward, a clear dark central seam; open dark margins above and below for annotation labels.
consistency_notes: Same person in both halves; the only differences are the mask and the inner glow. Cool palette, leave dark space for labels.
